what: Dedup test (5) proposes grepping stub claude argv for --context-files
scenario_or_breakage: launch-claude-review.sh invokes launch-claude-subprocess.sh by absolute path; subprocess consumes --context-files and calls claude with only --model/--print on stdin, so claude-argv.log never contains --context-files and the test false-fails or is vacuous
suggested_fix: Count <context_file_ tags in captured claude stdin (extend stub to tee stdin to $TMPROOT/claude-stdin.log), or add LARCH_LAUNCH_CLAUDE_SUBPROCESS_OVERRIDE and a logging subprocess stub that records argv
